xterm.js, vendored unchanged from the npm registry (MIT, see LICENSE.txt; the addons carry the same
licence text from the same authors). No CDN is used: the CSP allows scripts and styles from 'self' only.

@xterm/addon-canvas    0.7.0    addon-canvas.js  7b3e904d5bec98b54d26674994cf994396c4af0971010ffd0d4983229b65d933

Why the canvas renderer: xterm's default DOM renderer injects <style> elements, which a CSP without
'unsafe-inline' blocks. The canvas addon draws on <canvas> and needs no inline styles.

To update: npm pack @xterm/xterm@<v> @xterm/addon-fit@<v> @xterm/addon-canvas@<v>, copy lib/*.js and
css/xterm.css here, update this table (sha256sum *.js *.css).
